summary: 4 reviewers, 17 blocking findings (12 distinct after de-duplication), ~50 warnings/recommendations. Every distinct item is resolved in plan v2 (same file) and the spec revision of 2026-10-30.

blocking_issues.issue: react-native-modal is not mocked globally and breaks on RN 0.88; its patch lands in Task 7, after Task 3 must be green.
blocking_issues.resolution: Characterize modal behaviour on 0.72 first; pin 13.0.2 and apply the patch in the same install as RN 0.88.

blocking_issues.issue: The CI regroup-mobile job runs the typecheck ratchet before Jest; the plan defers the ratchet to Task 18, so CI is red and Jest unobserved for most of the PR. The spec requires the ratchet per phase.
blocking_issues.resolution: Keep the ratchet green at every commit: fix new errors in the task that causes them, and allow no baseline entries in Firebase-migrated files.

blocking_issues.issue: The Task 10 file groups name non-existent files (offlineQueue.ts, invites.ts) and omit integrity files (reopenDispute.ts, guestBatch.ts, useLiveHouseDisputes.ts, crud.tsx, account.ts, EnhancedAuthService.ts, invitations.ts, setup-wizard-photos.ts, useSubscriptionGate.ts).
blocking_issues.resolution: Regenerate the groups from call shapes plus imports; integrity files go to the integrity group; add a union check.

blocking_issues.issue: Collection refs and crud.tsx are shared across groups, so the groups cannot each land green with modular {path,type} mock refs.
blocking_issues.resolution: Dual-shape mock refs (modular refs also expose namespaced methods; namespaced refs carry path) until the last group lands.

blocking_issues.issue: Money and integrity characterization tests are rewritten together with the code, so a mapping mistake can be copied into the test.
blocking_issues.resolution: A normalized operation log shared by both mock shapes; tests are written against the log before the rewrite and stay byte-identical through it.

blocking_issues.issue: The completeness grep misses this codebase's call forms (firestore.collection, firestore.batch, FieldValue, messaging()).
blocking_issues.resolution: An ESLint ban on default @react-native-firebase imports plus an extended grep including ref-method chains.

blocking_issues.issue: The new async notification functions have no error observability and could log PII.
blocking_issues.resolution: Wrap with logException using a static context, never reject, never log payloads; test it.

blocking_issues.issue: The release-guard and e2e Gradle wiring is unverified and fails open.
blocking_issues.resolution: Required CI assertions, plus fail-closed configuration-time checks in app/build.gradle.

blocking_issues.issue: The test-change-approved label disables the whole CI test-tamper gate for the entire PR.
blocking_issues.resolution: Run the whole-branch verify-diff before applying the label, attach the output to the PR, and apply the label last.

blocking_issues.issue: iOS foreground banners for server pushes that carry a notification block disappear once AppDelegate stops being the UNUserNotificationCenter delegate.
blocking_issues.resolution: Set messaging_ios_foreground_presentation_options in firebase.json; add a checkpoint test.

blocking_issues.issue: AppDelegate loses its window property, crashing RNFB messaging at launch and breaking date-picker modals.
blocking_issues.resolution: Declare and assign the window property; add a static check and a checkpoint item.

blocking_issues.issue: IQKeyboardManager's Prev/Next/Done toolbar is the only way to dismiss iOS numeric pads (19 fields, including rent amount) and is lost with the library.
blocking_issues.resolution: An app-wide KeyboardToolbar behind a wrapper; audit column, tests, checkpoint item.

warnings: Native tracer bullet is too late (Android project should follow the JS bump, with a draft PR then).
Sentry v8 glue must land before the Mac checkpoint, including the Hermes source maps.
Snapshot updates must go in the same commit as the change that causes them.

Integration mapping: give it its own setup file, export JS SDK instances, keep an admin handle for seeding, normalize error codes, initialize before connecting, assert a demo- project, shim putFile, pin rules-unit-testing 5.0.2.
firebase-setup: extend the existing test, decide on the type re-exports, pass instances to the emulator wiring, test the ordering.
Wrapper pattern for notify-kit and keyboard-controller with ESLint allowlists; displayRemoteMessage in services/notifications.
Pending iOS reminders survive the upgrade: keep the same identifier and verify cancel by identifier.
Channels: await them via a memoized promise; declare POST_NOTIFICATIONS; decide on notify-kit's merged permissions; Android reminders now fire (new behaviour).
SceneDelegate: keep the start-once factory on AppDelegate and forward URLs on reconnect.
Edge-to-edge: the Android status-bar spacer and bottom insets need an explicit task.
Keyboard audit columns: FlatList nesting, pinned footers, Android, resetScrollToCoords, HouseSetup's Android height.
Path rule: docs/ and .claude/rules/ paths are under regroup/mobile.
Ratchet: no entries in migrated files; 1:1 mapping appendix.

Smaller items: permissions setup.rb require; rnvi-update-plist arguments and keeping Oswald/Roboto; DayTimeWidget path; RatsIcon solid mapping; geolocation HouseSearchScreen plus explicit options; document-picker edge cases; Sentry PII options; e2e sourceSets; firebase.md rule; baselines reconciled; engines; @types/react-test-renderer; reanimated override; split mocks under 300 lines; no it.each/merging; per-task mock lists; checkpoint additions (upgrade in place, 3DS, Hermes Intl/DST, Android 16 back, API 30, Maestro suite, E2EStaging, variant scripts, datepicker modal, scene disconnect, phone-auth URL).

re_review_v2.v3_resolution: Migration on RNFirebase 25.1.0 (both APIs typed; probe: +15 errors, fixed in the bump commit), 26.4.1 at Task 10f; fix-vector-icons removed with its apply in Task 5; integration suites mapped by load-time import graph; Task 9 lists integration files; exact inventory commands; .exists$ in grep; lazy Sentry task check; firebase.json block in both files; strong RN factory delegate and reconnect order; keyboard toolbar inside native Modals; temporary AGP9 patches deleted with their packages; xcode npm parser for pbxproj; iOS foreground options in notify-kit; RemoteMessage type; test-tamper red until label noted; revert before final gate run; Splash duplicate-listener fix and index.js console.log removal recorded.
